description: This walk visits the picturesque Lindores Loch near Newburgh and Cupar in Fife. The walk starts on the eastern side of the loch where there is some roadside parking. There is also a short path along the lochside here. The route then picks up a footpath heading east towards Dunbog Hill. Here you can enjoy some lovely countryside views from the elevated spot before descending back down to the lake. You can continue your walking in the area by heading south to visit the wildlife rich Birnie Loch Nature Reserve. Head into Cupar and there's a pleasant walk along the River Eden .
